speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Good so far!  Today I'm informing people about a charity called Save the Children.  Have you heard of them?

text: It sounds familiar, but I'm not sure.  It is a generic title.

text: They are a charity which promotes children's rights, provides relief and helps support children in developing countries

speaker: AYRJS25P2DQM
text: That sounds like a good charity.  I'm guessing that it is all international, and not local?

text: It's international.  They help all over the world!

text: They're very transparent with how they use their funding.  86% goes directly to their programs, 9% to fundraising, and the remaining 5% to management and general expenses

speaker: AYRJS25P2DQM
text: Those are good stats!

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Every day, 16,000 children die before their 5th birthday, mostly from preventable causes.  The charity is trying to change that

text: That is awful!  Is it mostly hunger and disease?

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Yes, mostly.  However some children pass due to violence and conflict in their countries.  1 in 80 children worldwide must flee their home in order to escape violence.

speaker: AYRJS25P2DQM
text: Children shouldn't have to suffer those kind of things.  They had nothing to do with the conflicts.

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Exactly!  Knowing that, would you be willing to donate ANY portion of your earnings for this HIT to the charity to help these children in need?

text: I would.  Do you know what difference it would make per dollar?

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
text: Every dollar makes a huge difference!  Over 3/4 of it will go directly to helping the children.  The remainder will indirectly also go to helping them by fundraising and management.  Would you like to donate $1.00 of your earnings?

speaker: AYRJS25P2DQM
text: I think that sounds fair?  Do you get to donate as well?

speaker: A1QJX8U3IIL5XQ
